d: Great atrium in Dom-Remy, which puts to the apartments prepared for the court. Borghigiani men and women, and some officers of the king.
Delil, Carlo, and sayings.

A forest. A small chapel rises directly above a practicable leap, lighted in a lamp. On the left side of the floor there is an oak tree, and at the foot of the foot there is a stone seat. In the bottom there is a cave. The sky is black and procellous. Giacomo solo, in the middle of Giovanna.
Joan alone descends from the leap.
Carlo from the jump, and said.
James not seen from the cave limits and sayings.

Remote place, scattered with rocks. In the distance I spotted part of the city of Rems. English soldiers scattered here and there in groups. Women crying near extinct, others assisting the wounded. Talbot.
Giacomo. His broken hair, his acts demonstrate the disorder of the mind.
Garden in the court of Rems. Joan alone. She is adorned with armor, helmet and sword; in the rest of women's dresses.
Carlo and said.
Delil with flags, King's officers and sayings.
Carlo and Giovanna.
Piazza in Rems; the cathedral dedicated to St. Dionysius rises on the front to the left. The scene is cluttered by the People.
Giacomo alone.
Joan comes out agitated, then Charles crowned, the Corteggio and the People. James is mingled with the crowd.

An interior of a fortress in the English field. A staircase leads to a tower, from which the fields are dominated. Joan, surrounded by large chains, is abandoned over a seat; next to her rises a stake. Except the helmet and the sword, she is dressed as before.
Joan, found herself locked up, stopped immobile; little by little animated to the inspiration. James entered, and stopped not seeing to contemplate her.
Giacomo alone.
French soldiers and officers, Charles is said.
Delil and sayings.
French soldiers with the banners that precede Joan, lying on the coffin. People men and women.
